archetypes.name: dyn-oos-rollup-embedding
archetypes.rationale: The capped rollup now embeds full item bodies inline; verify indentation keeps the aggregate parseable as exactly one block and never collides with field/heading markers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on _aggregate_block and the rolled-body selection in issue_cap in python/file_oos.py. Confirm every embedded body line is indented so it cannot match the ^-anchored DESC/REVIEWER/VOTE/PHASE or ### OOS_ regexes in issue_create.parse_issue_input, so the aggregate always parses as exactly one filing item carrying every body in its Description. Check edge cases: empty or whitespace-only bodies, bodies that themselves contain ### OOS_ headings or - **Field**: lines, inline code fences, and multi-line descriptions. Verify no detail is truncated and that _stable_ids_by_combined_item in oos_filer.py still counts only column-0 headings so stable-id mapping is unaffected. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
